title: Capacity Planning
selectProject: Select a project to view its capacity plans.

create.title: New Capacity Plan
create.noReleasesLeft: Every release in this project already has a plan.
create.unitFixedHint: The unit cannot be changed after the plan is created — every number on the plan uses it.
create.createFailed: Failed to create the capacity plan

detail.noTeams: No teams on this plan yet. Add one to start entering capacity.

row.capacityInvalid: Capacity must be a number of zero or more

tiers.allocatedHint: From committed allocations on this plan
tiers.preliminaryHint: From the preliminary T-shirt size, mapped by workspace settings

allocate.title: Allocate a Feature
allocate.defaultHint: Blank uses the Feature’s refined estimate, or its preliminary size — never the total already allocated.

warnings.feature_missing_estimate: This Feature has no estimate — no allocation, refined forecast or preliminary size to plan against
warnings.team_missing_capacity: No capacity entered for this team, so its capacity checks cannot run
warnings.rollup_exceeds_estimated: Child work has outgrown what was committed for this row
warnings.rollup_exceeds_capacity: Child work already exceeds the capacity
warnings.load_above_target: Committed demand is above the target load, leaving no room for unplanned work

breakdown.title: Capacity breakdown
breakdown.subtitle: Complete, Rollup and Estimated against each team’s capacity, in {{unit}}.
breakdown.noTeams: Add a team to see a breakdown.

forecast.title: Calculate capacity forecast
forecast.subtitle: Sampled from {{team}}’s accepted work in finished iterations.
forecast.availabilityHint: 100% is the team as it has recently been — 200% if it doubled, 50% if it halved.

complexity.minor_concerns: Somewhat new or unclear — minor concerns (−10%)
complexity.major_concerns: Somewhat new or unclear — major concerns (−25%)

forecast.basis: From {{iterations}} finished iterations over {{days}} days, modelled as {{modelled}} iterations of this plan’s window.

insufficient.no_history: This team has not finished an iteration yet, so there is nothing to sample. Enter a capacity by hand for now.
insufficient.too_little_history: Less than 14 days of history — too little to forecast from. Enter a capacity by hand, or wait for the current iteration to finish.
insufficient.no_window: This plan has no planned start and end dates, so there is no window to forecast into. Add the dates first.

publish.title: Publish this plan
publish.explain: Publishing makes the plan visible to everyone, not just planners.
publish.willWrite: Each Feature assigned to a team takes this plan’s planned start and end dates.
publish.releaseRule: The Release is written only when the plan’s window falls inside its release.
publish.revertWarning: Reverting later does NOT undo these field values — they must be cleared by hand.

skipReason.unallocated: no team assigned, so there was no plan for it to take
skipReason.release_span_mismatch: the plan’s window reaches outside its release, so the dates were written but the Release was not

revert.title: Revert this plan to draft?
revert.message: The plan becomes editable and planner-only again. The Release and planned dates already written onto Features are NOT undone — clear those by hand if you need to.
revert.done: Reverted to draft. Feature fields were left as they are.

items.empty: Allocate a Feature to see it here.
